meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能把任务交给本机 Ollama 模型:默认可列出已装模型、向指定模型发提示并拿回回答;开启管理开关后还能拉取、删除、查看模型等。
howto.when: 当你说“用 ollama”或要求本地模型做事时触发;管理类工具需先设 OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS=true 才会出现。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里

say.text: 把 gemma3:1b 模型拉下来
say.note: 需已开启管理工具开关,否则该工具不存在

say.text: 现在内存里加载了哪些 ollama 模型?

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can hand tasks to local Ollama models: by default it lists installed models and sends a prompt to a chosen model, returning the reply. With the admin flag on, it can also pull, delete and inspect models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to use ollama or a local model for a task. Management tools only appear if OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS=true is set in the container env.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France

say_en.note: Requires the admin tools flag to be enabled
